title: Design system — Beyond House Cleaning
summary: Technical contract between Claude Design and Claude Code defining design tokens, component contracts, page templates and SEO-driven CI locks for the BHC website rebuild.
scope: design tokens (colour, type, spacing, radii, motion)
React component library (Hero, Breadcrumbs, RatingBadge, NAPFooter, InterlinkBlock, Button)
page templates (home, service, locations index, town hub, combo, utility)
notes: Document embeds an ADR-like '## Decisions locked' table (colour strategy, visual direction, prescriptiveness, deliverable format) but is not structured as a standalone ADR (no Status/Context/Consequences, not numbered/filed as one decision). The dominant and larger portion of the document is an implementation contract: CSS custom-property tokens, TypeScript component prop interfaces, page-template composition, and a table of build-time CI assertions plus JSON-LD schema to emit — matching SPEC hallmarks. Classified as SPEC per the ADR>SPEC precedence tie-break being inapplicable (no true ADR structure present) and SPEC being the strongest sustained signal. Synthesizer may want to also lift the 'Decisions locked' table entries as locked-decision candidates.
